title: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart avoided 'devastating outcome' with knee injury against Rams

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart avoided 'devastating outcome' with knee injury against Rams
sources.description: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart appears to have avoided a 'devastating outcome' after suffering a left knee injury in Monday night's 28-6 loss to the Rams, coach John Harbaugh said.
